documents.title: ブルーカーボンデータ計測マニュアル Ver.1
documents.issuer: 国土交通省港湾局・港湾空港技術研究所

extracts.name: point_density_footprint
extracts.fact: Grid spatial resolution >=15 times one-beam footprint diameter; total footprint coverage should be comparable to or exceed the grid area; examples use different instruments.

extracts.name: bdas_green_laser_csv
extracts.fact: Four ordered mesh CSV fields x(m), y(m), vegetation height(m), intensity; two decimal places for measured coordinates/height; metadata includes survey date, seaweed/seagrass type, coordinate system.

extracts.name: reference_method_version
extracts.fact: Glossary cites an earlier J-Blue application handbook Ver.2.5, independently of user-provided J-Blue Ver.2.6.

documents.filename: R7_概要＿温暖化対策レポ.pdf
documents.title: 令和7年地球温暖化影響調査レポート（概要）

extracts.name: heat_effects
extracts.fact: Observed rice white immature grains caused by post-heading high temperatures; survey presents regional impact ranges rather than project-specific measurement.

extracts.name: heat_tolerant_rice
extracts.fact: 2025: 44 prefectures adopted heat-tolerant rice cultivars, national share 18.2% of table rice and 249,000 ha; prefectural shares supplied as reported.

documents.filename: 環境省・日本国温室効果ガスインベントリ2026.pdf
documents.title: National Greenhouse Gas Inventory Document of Japan 2026 第5章 農業分野
documents.issuer: 国立環境研究所等（日本国GHGインベントリ）
documents.edition: 2026公表・2024年度排出実績を含む

extracts.name: rice_2024_ch4
extracts.fact: 2024 rice paddy CH4 reported as 11,841 kt-CO2eq; Japan's usual midseason drainage classified single aeration in the national inventory.

extracts.name: dndc_rice_model
extracts.fact: DNDC-Rice Tier 3 emission factor modeling and modified Tier 2-based national emission calculation; regional area, drainage, water regime, organic matter and extension treatment enter the equation.

extracts.name: midseason_extension_reduction_national_assumption
extracts.fact: The national inventory uses 30% reduction in CH4 EF for extension in its model. This does not imply individual field eligibility or a J-Credit approval.

extracts.name: regional_factors
extracts.fact: Tables give regional/year/scenario-specific organic input and emissions factors; no entire coefficients imported to the research preview until independent tabular verification.

documents.filename: Jクレジット活用_中干し.pdf
documents.title: J-クレジット制度を活用して稲作の中干し期間延長に取り組んでみませんか？

extracts.name: extension_over_baseline
extracts.fact: Midseason drainage extension of at least 7 days compared with most recent two or more years' prior duration, with required registration and review; pamphlet describes ~30% methane reduction as indicative.

extracts.name: evidence_baseline
extracts.fact: Two or more years of past midseason drainage management records.

extracts.name: evidence_activity
extracts.fact: Start/end dates, duration, date of heading, paddy area and regional location, previous crop organic inputs; drainage evidence optional with supporting measurements; photographs and objective records.

extracts.name: farmer_safety_first
extracts.fact: If over-dry and yield risks arise, stop extension and apply water as appropriate; the brochure says rewatering during the extension is not accepted for J-Credit issuance.

extracts.name: hypothetical_price
extracts.fact: 5,000 JPY/tCO2 is only an explanatory assumed sales price (manager fees excluded); regional revenue examples are not market quotes.

cross_document_rules: MLIT manual references J-Blue handbook Ver.2.5 in glossary, whereas separate uploaded application handbook is Ver.2.6. Keep issuer/edition/role distinct.
NIES national inventory 30% extension model factor and MAFF educational brochure 30% explanatory claim do not authorize multiplying a project estimate into J-Credit supply.
MAFF 2025 climate adaptation rice cultivar shares are context variables, not an emission factor or direct carbon-credit quantifier.
No original PDF content uploaded to public GitHub; local exact SHA verification and human review are prerequisites to source-backed use.
J-Credit registry operations intentionally deferred to weekdays; never infer issuance/serial/custody from these PDFs.
